description: Summary figure: 26695 genomic start-site evidence, ortholog N-terminal comparison, and NADP contacts from the missing segment
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mp
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14,11))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3,1, height_ratios=[1.0,1.0,1.15], hspace=0.55)

# ---------- Panel A: genomic map of the 26695 locus ----------
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
seq_start=1580255; seq_end=1580345
dna="AGATCAGTTAGAAAGTAGGTGTTCCTTGCATACAGTATTACAAATTGGAGCTGGTGGCGTAGGCAGTGTGGTGGCACACAAAATGGGCATG"
assert len(dna)==seq_end-seq_start+1, len(dna)
x=np.arange(seq_start,seq_end+1)
ax.set_xlim(seq_start-1, seq_end+1); ax.set_ylim(-2.6,2.4)
for i,b in enumerate(dna):
    ax.text(seq_start+i, 0, b, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=7.2, family="monospace")
# codons of the extended ORF
for k in range(0,(1580345-1580280)//3+1):
    s=1580280+3*k
    if s+2<=seq_end:
        ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((s-0.5,-0.45),3,0.9,fill=False,ec="0.75",lw=0.6))
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1580280-0.5,-0.5),3,1.0,fc="#2b7a4b",alpha=0.55,ec="#14532d",lw=1.4))
ax.text(1580281,1.0,"TTG\n1580280-82\nproposed start",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=8,color="#14532d")
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1580322-0.5,-0.5),3,1.0,fc="#b5651d",alpha=0.55,ec="#7c3f0d",lw=1.4))
ax.text(1580323,1.0,"GTG\n1580322-24\nO26037 / AAD08549 start",ha="center",va="bottom",fontsize=8,color="#7c3f0d")
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1580271-0.5,-0.5),5,1.0,fc="#4169aa",alpha=0.35,ec="#1f3f73",lw=1.0))
ax.text(1580273,-1.1,"AGGTG\n16S anti-SD duplex, spacer 4 nt",ha="center",va="top",fontsize=7.5,color="#1f3f73")
# peptide track for the 14-residue extension
pep="MHTVLQIGAGGVGS"
for k,aa in enumerate(pep):
    s=1580280+3*k
    ax.text(s+1,-2.0,aa,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8,family="monospace",
            color="#14532d",fontweight="bold")
ax.annotate("", xy=(1580322,-2.0), xytext=(1580280,-2.0),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color="#14532d", lw=1.2))
ax.text(1580301,-2.45,"42 nt in frame, no stop codon",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#14532d")
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([1580260,1580280,1580300,1580320,1580340])
ax.set_xlabel("AE000511.1 coordinate (plus strand)",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A. H. pylori 26695 HP_1507 locus: an in-frame TTG 42 nt upstream of the annotated GTG",
             fontsize=11,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel B: N-terminal alignment ----------
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
rows=[
 ("26695 extended / WP_015056101.1 (399)","MHTVLQIGAGGVGSVVAHKMGMNRD",0),
 ("H. acinonychis Sheeba Q17ZI8 (399)",  "MHTVLQIGAGGVGSVVAHKMGMNRD",0),
 ("H. cetorum MIT 99-5656 I0ESJ2 (399)", "MHTVLQIGAGGVGSVVAHKMGMNRD",0),
 ("H. cetorum MIT 00-7128 I0EKU9 (399)", "MHTVLQIGAGGVGGVVAHKMGLNRD",0),
 ("H. cappadocius A0AA90PPK2 (399)",     "MNAVLQIGAGGVGGVVAHKLAMNRE",0),
 ("H. mustelae D3UGV5 (399)",            "MSTVLQIGAGGVGGVVAHKLARNKQ",0),
 ("H. heilmannii A0A0K2YBB9 (403)",      "MLTVLQIGAGGVGRVVAHKLAQNRH",0),
 ("H. felis E7ADD4 (403)",               "MSVVLQIGAGGVGNVVAHKLCQNRQ",0),
 ("H. suis A0A6J4D0M1 (403)",            "MLTVLQIGAGGVGSVVAHKLCQNRD",0),
 ("H. pylori 26695 O26037 (385)",        "MVAHKMGMNRD",14),
 ("H. pylori G27 B5Z9C5 (380)",          "MGMNRD",19),
]
ax.set_xlim(-0.5,26); ax.set_ylim(-0.6,len(rows)-0.4)
for r,(lab,s,off) in enumerate(rows):
    y=len(rows)-1-r
    outlier = "O26037" in lab or "B5Z9C5" in lab
    ax.text(-0.8,y,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=8,
            color="#b5651d" if outlier else "0.15")
    for i,aa in enumerate(s):
        col="#14532d" if (off==0 and i<14) else ("#b5651d" if outlier else "0.25")
        bg = "#cfe8d8" if (off==0 and 7<=i<=13) else None
        if bg: ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((off+i-0.45,y-0.4),0.9,0.8,fc=bg,ec="none"))
        ax.text(off+i,y,aa,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,family="monospace",
                fontweight="bold" if i==0 else "normal", color=col)
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((7.55,-0.5),6.9,len(rows)-0.1,fill=False,ec="#2b7a4b",lw=1.3,ls="--"))
ax.text(11,len(rows)-0.5,"Rossmann GxGxxG fingerprint (G8-A9-G10-G11-V12-G13)",
        ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#14532d")
ax.set_xticks(range(0,26,2)); ax.set_xticklabels(range(1,27,2),fontsize=7)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("position in the 399-residue numbering",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("B. Annotated N-termini of Helicobacter orthologs: the two H. pylori reference entries are the outliers",
             fontsize=11,loc="left")
for s in ["top","right","left"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel C: NADP contacts from the missing segment ----------
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
cont=pd.DataFrame([
 (8,"Gly","CA","backbone","O4B",3.95),(9,"Ala","N","backbone","O3B",3.29),
 (9,"Ala","CA","backbone","O3B",3.73),(9,"Ala","C","backbone","O3B",3.60),
 (9,"Ala","O","backbone","O3B",3.82),(9,"Ala","CB","side chain","O3B",3.83),
 (10,"Gly","N","backbone","O5B",3.76),(10,"Gly","CA","backbone","O5B",3.05),
 (10,"Gly","C","backbone","O1N",3.46),(11,"Gly","N","backbone","O1N",2.91),
 (11,"Gly","CA","backbone","O1N",3.72),(11,"Gly","C","backbone","O1N",3.99),
 (12,"Val","N","backbone","O1N",3.26),(12,"Val","CB","side chain","O5D",3.75),
 (12,"Val","CG2","side chain","O5D",3.87)],
 columns=["resi","resn","atom","moiety","nap","d"])
lab=[f"{r.resn}{r.resi} {r.atom}" for r in cont.itertuples()]
cols=["#2b6cb0" if m=="backbone" else "#c05621" for m in cont.moiety]
y=np.arange(len(cont))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,cont.d,color=cols,height=0.65)
for yy,r in zip(y,cont.itertuples()):
    ax.text(r.d+0.04,yy,f"{r.d:.2f} A to {r.nap}",va="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8,family="monospace")
ax.set_xlim(0,5.0); ax.axvline(4.0,color="0.5",ls="--",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("distance to nearest NADP atom in 8H52 (Angstrom)",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("C. All NADP contacts within 4 A contributed by residues 1-14, the segment absent from O26037:\n"
             "12 backbone atoms (blue) and 3 side-chain atoms (orange)",fontsize=11,loc="left")
h=[mp.Patch(color="#2b6cb0",label="backbone"),mp.Patch(color="#c05621",label="side chain")]
ax.legend(handles=h,fontsize=8,loc="lower right",frameon=False)
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
